newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka's Kelani Valley jumps 6.25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka's Kelani Valley jumps 6.25 pct.

text.p: Shares in estate firm Kelani Valley Plantations Ltd rose 6.25 percent, or one rupee, to 17 rupees following the government's sale of a controlling stake in a state-owned estate firm, dealers said.
"A 51 percent stake in Agarapatana being bidded up to 35.25 rupees a 10-rupee share on Friday has focused attention on plantations," one broker said.
Lankem Plantation Holdings Ltd bought the controlling interest in Agarapatana Plantations Ltd which was offered as part of the government's privatisation programme.
Six estate firms, including Kelani Valley, are already traded on the Colombo bourse after being privatised in the programme that began late last year.
